description: Returns a receiver's man vs zone splits (2025 season) and blitz splits (2026 season to date) next to this week's opponent's coverage tendencies (man/zone mix, shells, what it allows) and 2026 blitz rate, with a one-line plain read. Use it for "how does he match up with the coverage he will see Sunday?". Splits under 15 targets are flagged small_sample. No slot/wide alignment data. Basic plan and above.

player_id.description: GridIron player id, "First Last#POS", matched case-insensitively. Defenses are "Team Name#DST". Unsure of the id? Call search_players first.
player_id.title: Player Id

week.description: NFL regular-season week, 1-18. Default: the current week.
week.title: Week

name: get_coverage_matchup

error.description: Present only when the call failed: what went wrong.

opponent_defense.description: The opponent's 2025 man/zone rates, shells and allowed lines, and its 2026 blitz rate.

player.description: His 2025 man/zone lines and 2026 vs_blitz/no_blitz lines.

read.description: One plain sentence comparing his better split with what the opponent leans on.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure reason, e.g. basic_required or pro_required.

required_plan.description: The plan that unlocks this data: basic or pro.

source.description: Attribution: nflverse, CC-BY-4.0; blitz charting is FTN data via nflverse.

status.description: HTTP status of the failed API call.
